caption: Duomo of Como, Como
composition: Gothic-Renaissance Como Cathedral with green dome · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The cathedral fills the frame, seen from the piazza before its west front. The Gothic façade rises in the center with its great rose window and pinnacled gable, while the green copper dome looms behind it at the right. The long nave flank stretches to the left and a Renaissance palazzo adjoins at the right edge. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 10:01 Europe/Rome: bright mid-morning sun on the pale marble.
